additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0379648-DC/Si-D/AT[170003381 & 170002084] - 0 meter values at StopTransaction CRM:00315001781
additional_info.body:
Hallo Johannes
this invalid record is caused by a ReverseVoltageError getting observed by the LEM-Meter so that the meter sends a Invalid record due to this wrong MeterValue. The RnD is investigating to indentify why the meter is getting a reversevoltage, maybe its from the EV or something is causing a negative Voltage on the V2G line. Currently tests are ongoing, will let you know if we get any news.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Semih

Hi Semih,
danke dass du das kontrolliert hast.
Nein das waren wir nicht.
Ist eventuell im Zuge des "Reversed Voltage" Problems des Zählers oder im Zuge der Temperaturumverkabelung von Service umgestellt worden.
Das darf Aufgrund der Vorgaben und OCMF Daten nicht deaktiviert werden.
Kannst du da bitte wieder aktiveren.
Kannst du uns eventuell auch bei dem "Reversed Voltage" Problem helfen.
Müssen wir hier wirklich den Zähler tauschen?
Das ist aufgrund der Nacheichung nicht so einfach.
Wo lag nun genau da Problem an den neune 0 Sessions?
Gab es hier ein Timing Problem mit dem LEM?
LG,
Johannes

additional_info.body:
Hallo Johannes
Ist eventuell im Zuge des "Reversed Voltage" Problems des Zählers oder im Zuge der Temperaturumverkabelung von Service umgestellt worden.
Das darf Aufgrund der Vorgaben und OCMF Daten nicht deaktiviert werden.
Kannst du da bitte wieder aktiveren.
Ich stell ERK wieder ein sobald keine session laufen
Kannst du uns eventuell auch bei dem "Reversed Voltage" Problem helfen.
Müssen wir hier wirklich den Zähler tauschen?
Das ist aufgrund der Nacheichung nicht so einfach.
Also soweit ich weiß wurde da nur SW Technisch was angepasst, ist mir neu das die LEM getauscht werden müssen aber ich bin nicht tief in der Thematik aktuell
Wo lag nun genau da Problem an den neune 0 Sessions?
Gab es hier ein Timing Problem mit dem LEM?
The reason for that is, that the backend gets an error while stopping the LEM transaction. This happens because the PLC stops the LEM transaction (s. BYD workaraound) but if the backend asks if the LEM transaction is stopped then the LEM answers with transaction is running. In that case the backend stops the transaction. But then the LEM asweres wit an error (Error: PUT
http://10.20.17.20/v2/legal?transactionId=92674d2640ec4177
returned: 412 - Precondition Failed).
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
eMobility Tech Support Team

additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
I hope my message finds you well.
Ticket ID0379648
will be closed immediately as its continued use for new cases deviates from our established process.
This ticket was specifically for issues on Firmware v6.1.3, which were tackled and partially corrected by v7.0 (Issue reported to R&D ticket EVC3-8990).
Documenting new cases here is inappropriate as it pertains to obsolete implementations and significantly disrupts our ticket flow. Furthermore, there is no action pending from Service teams on this ticket and reporting to R&D has been completed; therefore, it will be closed as per the established process.
Please note that all tickets where no action is pending from Service teams, and R&D reporting is concluded will be closed in accordance with our process, without exception.
Please be assured that ongoing issues related to Firmware v7.0 are already being tracked under ISP ticket ID0425226, with a solution anticipated in Firmware v8.1.
We will take care of connecting ticket ID0379648 to ID0425226 to ensure proper traceability and process continuity. As clarified above, ticket ID0425226 will be closed as well, as there is no action pending from Service teams and reporting to R&D has been completed.
For all future customer cases, regardless of similarity, a new, distinct ticket must be opened. If symptoms persist on newer Firmware versions, a new ticket explicitly referencing the latest FW is mandatory. Related cases should be linked using the "case relationships" function, which is valid for both active and resolved tickets.
Our HQ support teams rely on new ISP tickets to accurately reflect issues on the latest FW versions for R&D bug-reporting, internal service reporting statistics and ultimately reflecting the impact on the installed base according to product-specific KPIs.
Strict adherence to these processes is crucial for efficient issue resolution and accurate reporting.
Summary of status and action items:
Ticket ID0379648:
Closed immediately due to non-compliance; refers to obsolete v6.1.3 issues tackled by v7.0. No service action is pending and reporting to R&D is completed; closure is per established process. This applies to all tickets in a similar status.
Firmware v7.0 Issues
: Already reported and actively followed up via ISP ID0425226; solution expected in v8.1. No service action is pending and reporting to R&D is completed; the ticket will be closed.
Ticket Linking:
ID0379648 will be connected to ID0425226 by us to ensure proper case relationship management.
Required Action:
Open new, distinct tickets for every new customer case, especially for issues on current Firmware versions.
Process:
Utilize "case relationships" for linking related tickets;
We are available for any guidance needed to ensure smooth adherence to these critical processes.
Many thanks in advance for your understanding.
With best regards,
